replies.author: Kalaminator
replies.body:
Why do we pretend to be developers? I am not one, and judging by your game, you are not one either, or so I hope. 

I'm doing something else and I need the tokens for several projects I'm working on (not only games, I'm using AI to organize files for a court case) 

One of the projects I'm working on is a digital adaptation of the game  Root. My idea with this game, because there is already a digital adaptation, is to have the chance to add fan factions (over 90) and balance the factions by building a Jax engine trainer in python to see which factions are stronger.

The game is far from perfect because I'm working on it right now, but for the maps, it has a map editor that allows you to generate terrain on the map created, etc.

https://kalaminator.github.io/Dominion/
